caption: The drawing depicts a wooden side table with a rectangular top, colored in various shades of light to medium brown to represent wood grain. The table features two drawers in the front, each with a circular knob matching the wood color. The structure is supported by a single, thick, turned central pedestal leg. At the base, the pedestal connects to a four-pointed support frame, each point ending in a small, round foot or caster. The entire composition uses consistent brown tones to illustrate the wooden surfaces and shadows, and the background is left plain and uncolored.
title: Drop-leaf Table
